text:
PROTOCOL_INSPECTION::id
Description
This command provides inspection match result, returning inspection
match ids in the form of an array.
Syntax
PROTOCOL_INSPECTION
::
id
Examples
In the example, the PROTOCOL_INSPECTION::id array is logged.
when
PROTOCOL_INSPECTION_MATCH
{
set
id
[
PROTOCOL_INSPECTION
::
id
]
log
local0.debug
"inspection id: $id"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
PROTOCOL_INSPECTION_MATCH
